data_description.name: The agent's name, as the voice assistant settings and its device show it.
data_description.prompt: What the text model is told before every conversation. Templates allowed.

models.name: Models
models.description: Who answers: a decision model for simple commands, a text model for everything else.

data_description.model: Answers every request the decision model passes on, with the tools below.
data_description.temperature: How much the text model's replies vary. Low values suit a voice assistant. Empty: the server's default.
data_description.decider: A small decision model carries out simple commands (lights, timers, lists) itself, faster than the text model. Off: the text model answers every request.
data_description.decider_model: The decision model this agent uses, from the decision server's models. Needed when the server offers several. Empty: the server's only model.
data_description.threshold: How sure the decision model must be to act on its own, from 0 to 1. Below it, the request goes to the text model. Higher: fewer wrong actions, more requests passed on.
data_description.answer_model: Words the reply after the decision model has acted, and splits a request with several commands. A small, fast model is enough. Empty: the text model.
data_description.fallback_agent: Another conversation agent, such as a cloud assistant, that answers the requests the decision model passes on, in place of the text model. The answer model still words the decision model's replies. Empty: the text model.

reasoning.name: Thinking
reasoning.description: How the text model reasons before it answers.

data.send_reasoning: Send the model's earlier reasoning back

data_description.thinking: Turns thinking on or off, for models that support it. Empty: the server's default.
data_description.reasoning_effort: How long the model thinks, for models that take an effort level. Empty: the server's default.
data_description.thinking_token_budget: The most thinking tokens per request, for servers that support a limit. Empty: no limit.
data_description.send_reasoning: In a turn with several rounds, the model sees what it thought before. Some thinking models need it, or their reply after a tool call can get lost. Recommended: on.

tools.name: Tools
tools.description: What the text model can do and look up.

data_description.llm_hass_api: The sets of tools the model may use, such as Assist (devices), AI Suite (its tool sets) and Second Brain (memory).
data_description.hidden_tools: Tools the model does not get. The list shows the tools of the saved APIs: after changing the APIs, save and open again. Tools AI Suite replaces with its own are left out already.
data_description.parallel_tool_calls: The model may call several tools in one round. Off: one tool per round.

replies.name: Replies
replies.description: Checks and clean-up before the user hears a reply.

data_description.reply_check: A reply in the wrong language, with numbers no tool gave, or with raw text is written once more, unless the model has already acted. Costs time only on such a reply.
data_description.strip_emojis: Removes emojis before the reply is spoken.
data_description.max_message_history: How many earlier exchanges of the conversation the text model sees. Empty: all.

init.title: Trace monitor
init.description: Sends each turn of the AI Suite agents to a trace monitor: the decisions, the model calls, the tools, the state changes the turn caused and, for voice turns, the pipeline's timings.

data_description.monitor_enabled: Off: nothing is recorded or sent, and the URL and token may stay empty.
data_description.monitor_url: The monitor's base URL, without a path, such as http://192.0.2.10:8000.
data_description.monitor_token: The bearer token the monitor accepts for its ingest, from its token file.
data_description.monitor_audio: Also uploads each voice turn's wake word and speech recording. Needs `assist_pipeline: debug_recording_dir:` in configuration.yaml. AI Suite deletes each run folder after uploading it.

error.invalid_url: Not an http or https URL
error.invalid_auth: The monitor does not accept this token
error.not_a_monitor: This server has no trace monitor ingest
error.unknown: The monitor gave an unexpected answer

no_agent_selected.title: No conversation agent is using Second Brain
no_agent_selected.description:
Memory is set up, but no conversation agent uses Second Brain, so the assistant has no access to your notes and cannot remember anything.

Open the agent's settings (Settings > Devices & services > AI Suite, Configure on the agent) and tick **Second Brain** under Tools > LLM APIs.

calendars_not_exposed.title: Calendars are not exposed to the assistant
calendars_not_exposed.description:
`get_calendar_events` can only read calendars that are exposed to Assist, and Home Assistant does not expose the calendar domain by default - so appointment questions currently return nothing.

Go to Settings > Voice assistants > Expose and expose the calendars you want the assistant to read.

store_unavailable.title: Memory is off: its store cannot be used
store_unavailable.description:
{problem}

The conversation agents keep working without memory. Change the store's location in the Memory settings.

store_offline.title: Memory is waiting for its store
store_offline.description:
The store at {path} was set up before and is not there now: is the network share offline?

The conversation agents keep working without memory. When a turn needs memory, AI Suite looks for the store again (at most every 5 minutes) and reloads once it is back.

memory_api_taken.title: Memory is off: another integration serves its LLM API
memory_api_taken.description: The LLM API `{api_id}` is already served, most likely by the separate Second Brain integration. AI Suite's memory replaces it: remove the Second Brain integration, then reload AI Suite.

llm_server_unreachable.message: The LLM server does not answer: {error}

llm_server_error.message: The LLM server returned an error. Check the system log for details.

no_text_model.message: {entity_id} has no text model set, so it cannot answer this request.

feature_missing.message: This needs the {feature} feature and a running Memory. Add it on the AI Suite entry, or check the log for why Memory did not start.

consolidate.name: Consolidate memories
consolidate.description: Runs the librarian now: merges the raw memories into curated wiki pages and moves misfiled facts out of the rules. New memories wait until it finishes, up to 10 minutes on a slow model. Returns a summary of what it changed. Fails when the model gives no usable plan or one past the limits.

learn.name: Learn from failures
learn.description: Runs the self-improvement pass now: turns a repeated pattern in failures.md into a rule in self_improving.md, retracts learned rules that went wrong, and marks what it handled. Returns a summary of what it changed. Fails when the model gives no usable plan or one past the limits.
